experiment: V0.6.0 source-prior and seed-ranking offline retrieval evaluation
controlled_conditions: same task descriptions, base commits, gold-patch file labels, candidate limit, repository graph edges and filename-keyword baseline as the prior graph evaluation
new_ranking_features: lower prior for doc, examples, benchmarks and test directories
higher score for explicit task module names
separate import, call and test edge weights
interpretation: On this three-task offline screen, source-prior and explicit-module seed ranking improve Hit@1 and MRR while retaining graph-based Hit@5. The sample is too small to claim generalization or Agent repair-rate improvement.
